en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a riverside or canal in a small town. On the right bank stand large wooden houses with steep roofs and many windows, with smaller houses and buildings scattered up the hill behind them. Trees frame the scene, and calm water fills the foreground with a curved stone embankment and benches on the left. Printed text at the top reads in Swedish that the motif is from Uddevalla.
